finish_time.note: a range, not a promise: it assumes the laid build completes, and race day rides fuelling, pacing, weather and the day's legs. The median is the trend signal — more runway → higher fitness → faster — and the band narrows as runs land and raced results calibrate it.

feasibility.note: Projected fitness by race day ≈ CTL 112 (from 66 now, via the engine's projection through the planned blocks (ACWR-capped)) — at/above the ~CTL 45 a healthy marathon finish needs. That supports **finishing Demo Marathon healthy**; the engine re-reads this each block as measured fitness moves. Projected finish **2:09:30–2:48:30** (median 2:27:43) — the range narrows as runs land.

note: Easy pace ~5:02/km — if your easy runs are habitually faster than this they're really threshold effort; the re-base deliberately runs slower to build the aerobic base. (See the Effort-discipline panel for how your actual easy runs measure up.)
